name: vorth-backend
description: Backend API for Vorth — a novel & comic reading platform. Auth with rotating refresh tokens, series/chapters, comments, library, reading progress, notifications, rankings, uploads (local or S3-compatible), and a DMCA takedown pipeline. Ships with an empty catalog; `npm run db:seed` adds demo content on request.
